shots.text: Vholt Stormcrown taught Kaela to ride. When his thunderbird fell, she was the one waiting at the bottom of the canyon.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The black thunderbird crashing on the terraces. Vholt crawling free. If Kaela is in the party, she stands over him with her lance; otherwise, a lone Galeborn rider.

shots.text: You always did hold the reins too tight. Go on, girl.
shots.speaker: vholt
shots.art_note: Vholt's face, the grey light flickering out of his eyes as he looks up.

shots.text: Behind a collapsed terrace we found what was left of the Canyon's shield-company. One of them was still standing, holding a door.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Gorrim Stonebeard, short and wide, a carved stone door as a shield, iron rings in his beard, standing in front of exhausted soldiers.

shots.text: One ring for each friend I've buried. I've no room left on this beard, Spirewright. Let's keep it that way.
shots.speaker: gorrim
shots.art_note: Gorrim hefting the door-shield onto his back. Joins as a hero.
